title: Show only location text in search autocomplete recommendations

requirements.text: Update the public listings search Location autocomplete recommendations so that suggestions display and return only property location values (do not include or match against property titles).

quotes: proprty title also showing in recommandation . we dont need that only the location is enough

acceptanceCriteria: Typing in the public search Location field shows autocomplete suggestions that are locations only (no property titles appear in the dropdown).
Selecting an autocomplete suggestion populates the Location input with that location text exactly (no title prefix/suffix).

Backend method `getBackendAutocompleteSuggestions(input, maxResults)` only searches/matches against stored `property.location` values (not `property.title`) while keeping case-insensitive matching, de-duplication, and `maxResults` limiting behavior.
Update any frontend comments/docs that claim the autocomplete searches titles so they accurately reflect location-only behavior.

constraints: Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (do not add additional backend services).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Changing the overall UI layout/styling of the search bar beyond what is necessary to remove title-based suggestions.
Reintroducing Google Places or any external autocomplete provider.
Changing property search filtering behavior (only autocomplete suggestions scope is changing).
